software_experiments.test_policy: Only original human-labeled classes, GPS before label timestamp from same individual within <=120 s, no exact animal GPS locations exported, leave ENTIRE individuals out in every fold.
software_experiments.matched_prediction_models: Two equal one-bit representations of ground speed, one minimizes train-only speed MSE, other maximizes train-only label-balanced accuracy. No behavior utility actually measured; this is a cognitive representation proxy, NOT proof of Hoffman's ontology.
software_experiments.case_for_retinal_map_to_action_joint_hyp: NOT_IDENTIFIABLE: eye fields and observed behavior belong to different gull cohorts.

scientific_next_gate: Download original 10-gull eye DOCX via verified official link or author, and obtain physically matched visual stimulus/head/gaze plus action/reward data from the same birds. Independently replicated held-out bird behavior score is a partial prerequisite, not evidence that spatial reality is an illusion.
